seo.title: Price Tracking and Liquidity Fragility in Hybrid CEX/DEX Crypto Markets
seo.description: An agent-based CEX/DEX thesis with a reproducible, browser-based simulation lab.

research.title: Start with the question.
research.intro: The repository follows the way a thesis is examined: question, method, evidence, and argument—each available as a separate, inspectable artifact.
research.briefText: Context, research question, contribution, and the boundaries of the present version.
research.evidenceText: Notebooks turn an analytical claim into traceable inputs, assumptions, and outputs.
research.artifactText: Final thesis PDFs, release record, and methods remain connected.

playground.title: Simulation playground
playground.intro: Adjust inputs. See the model update in your browser.
playground.trackingIntro: A one-time CEX shock moves the reference price. The DEX pool responds only through the selected capacity-limited arbitrage rule.
playground.depthIntro: Compare the same x-sale before and after a proportional liquidity withdrawal from an otherwise identical pool.
playground.assumptionsText: Synthetic zero-fee constant-product pool (x · y); the CEX is an exogenous reference, and the log band is a cost proxy. This is a mechanism demonstration, not empirical evidence or hypothesis validation.
playground.saleHelp: Same sale amount in both pools
playground.withdrawalText: Proportional withdrawal preserves the marginal price; it changes depth before the same fixed sale.

notebook.title: Evidence that can be revisited.
notebook.intro: Each notebook has one purpose, a readable scope, and a route back to the chapter it informs.

docs.title: Notes around the result.
docs.intro: The surrounding documentation names assumptions, explains the reproduction path, and records the current limits of the work.
